panels.description: Security shutters descend through the Halyard maker district. The purifier room and collaborators remain visible behind the closing metal; leave upper area for sound lettering.
Alex, Ada and Lina are separated from the other makers by the barrier. Make the barrier the dominant division; leave upper space.
Alex jams his damaged wrist guard into the shutter track. Leave upper-left clear for his command.
Ada catches the access tool Alex throws across the gap and closes her hand around it. Keep its trajectory and her grip clear; leave upper space for her line.
